# NIGHTSHIFT — nightshift.hartwell-labs.pl

> Commercial FiveM resource by Hartwell Labs: bodycam, dashcam, evidence locker
> and wilderness survival. Every death becomes a 12-second clip. Full edition
> ($80) burns a watermark into an MP4 and posts it to Discord; Lite edition
> ($40) records locally on the game server with a creator banner and no relay.

## Pages

- [NIGHTSHIFT product page](/index.md): modules, editions, prices, honest
  limits, install steps, FAQ and the design specification.

## Company

- [Hartwell Labs](https://hartwell-labs.pl/): publisher.
- [llms.txt of the main site](https://hartwell-labs.pl/llms.txt): full index.
